'''ben_ethus When Feral Teddybears Attack!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ben_ethus]]
* '''Published:''' 7 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 TIGIH ben_ethus LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Beware The Bears!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Turn #1: Before you activate anything, use Strike Planning and Rycar(V) to their fullest potential by immediately pulling Madine, Rieekan, Lightsaber Proficiency, and Obi Wan's journal.  Activate your force.  Try to fire off a quick force drain of 1 at Chirpa's Hut with Luke.  Deploy Lightsaber Proficiency  and Obi's Journal on Luke.  Deploy Madine to Landing Platform.  If force allows, try to get an Ithorian at the Landing Platform.  Have Madine pull Chewie into hand.  Move Luke to the Landing Platform.

Turn #2: Unless your opponent decided to be foolish and tried to bring the fight to you on the Landing Platform, you should have a force drain of AT LEAST 3.  4 with an Ithorian.  Deploy Chewie to the Platform.  Chewie downloads Wuta for free.  Use Wuta to pull another Endor site (Back Door is preferable).  Divide your forces accordingly between the two sites to effectively hold them.

At this point you're more or less just playing goalie on Endor, though you'll want to eventually deploy Rieekan, who will pull 'Lock,' who will pull the Endor system, which you'll want to fortify with your space force, so as to avoid any force drain payment penalties.

Ideally, you'll be able to have 3 Endor sites down, an Ithorian at each, with a few guys there to hold it, with at least 2 Ewoks at each to reap benefit of Ewok Celebration.  With all the crazy Ewok bonuses, Run, Luke, Run! to fly him around, Ewok Rescues, and Ewok Spears, winning battles shouldn't be an issue if the opponent is brave enough to try to fight you.  You'll also be force draining for a pretty ridiculous amount each turn.

Rundown of Crazy Ewok Celebration Bonus:
-------------------------------------------
With 2 Ewoks present at a site (which has 1 natural blue force slash), and 1 Ithorian...

Your Ewok Sentries will each be Power = 2, Forfeit = 6, Defense Value = 4.
Ewok Spearmen (w/spear) will be Power = 4, Forfeit = 6, Defense Value = 4.
(Not to shabby for using a mere one or two force!)

Odds and Ends:
------------------
Kazak will beef up your force drains even more if you're lucky enough to get him out.
Figrin D'an is around for some retrieval.
Bacta Tank to help keep your Ewoks running around.
Reflection for more retrieval.
Wokling to toughen up your forces.
Sound the Attack can both pull Ewok Spears and add destiny draws.  (Score!)
Houjix & OON in case something goes horribly awry, or want to add a battle destiny in space.
NS Windchimes & OOS to pull Ithorians, or pull another character to a battle in a clutch.
Ewok Spears can make the mightiest Dark Jedi look like a total sissy.

If Luke does eventually get kidnapped by an Imperial, you can try to rescue him with Ewok Rescue, or just let the guy have him, having your opponent take 2 damage each turn.  If Vader kidnaps him, maybe you'll be lucky enough to have enough cards stacked under I Feel The Conflict to pull an instant win.  Unlikely, but you never know...
